Simple Process

How It Works

From your first call to the final installation, we keep things simple and stress-free.

Step 1

Free Consultation

Book a visit and we bring fabric samples to your door. Our consultant measures every window and discusses your style preferences and budget.

Step 2

Fabric Selection

Browse hundreds of fabrics and finishes in your own lighting. We help you choose colours, textures, and styles that complement your interior.

Step 3

Tailoring

Our experienced tailors cut and stitch every piece to exact measurements. Quality checks happen at every stage for a premium finish.

Step 4

Installation

We install tracks, rods, blinds, or flooring with care and precision. We test every mechanism and leave your home spotless.
